verdict.rationale: Canny documents linking feedback to existing issues and tasks in Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp and Asana, with status sync. It also mentions querying 'your team's roadmap' via MCP and a changelog that ties shipped work back to closed feedback. None of this explicitly shows linking requests to roadmap features, initiatives or releases inside Canny. Missing for 10: explicit native linking of requests to roadmap features, initiative-level grouping, documented request-to-release (changelog entry) linking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
